assessment_metadata.title: ByteShield IT Support - Critical Risk Assessment
assessment_metadata.assessor_notes: CRITICAL ESCALATION: Outsourced MSP technician review indicates unacceptable shared root credential practices and unmonitored VPN jump hosts.

answers.evidence: Remote jump host allows password-only authentication; MFA not enforced for MSP technicians.
answers.gap_notes: High risk of credential stuffing and unauthorized lateral movement.

answers.evidence: Generic shared 'administrator' account shared among 8 offshore technicians without individual audit logging.
answers.gap_notes: Lack of accountability and complete violation of least privilege RBAC.

answers.evidence: Data encrypted in transit via VPN, but administrative session logs stored unencrypted in plain text.
No documented data return or cryptographic sanitization procedure upon technician termination.
answers.gap_notes: Residual data lingering on technician personal workstations.

answers.evidence: Vendor does not commit to any breach notification window; standard contract is completely silent on cybersecurity incidents.
answers.gap_notes: Unacceptable exposure in the event of ransomware or active adversary presence.

answers.evidence: No recurring vulnerability scans conducted; servers running end-of-life operating systems without vendor support.
answers.gap_notes: Multiple unpatched known CVEs exposed on the management perimeter.

answers.evidence: Vendor possesses no independent security attestations (no SOC 2, ISO 27001, or Cyber Essentials Plus).
answers.gap_notes: Zero independent verification of security posture.

answers.evidence: Backups taken weekly to local NAS, but not air-gapped or immutable; no restoration test performed in the last 18 months.
answers.gap_notes: High vulnerability to total data loss in a ransomware outbreak.

answers.evidence: Vendor subcontracts support tickets to unvetted Tier-4 third parties without our knowledge or approval.
Basic ID check performed upon hire, but no formal criminal background checks or ongoing phishing training.
